summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou continue their complex, semi-antagonistic relationship. Shen Feizhi is orchestrating a fake engagement with Lu Qian to appease Elder Master Shen and bring Lu Fan into the fold. Gu Suizhou, acting as a 'green tea' personality, is intensely jealous and insecure about Shen Feizhi's interactions with others. After Shen Feizhi sends a rare 'head-pat' emoji to Gu Suizhou, Gu Suizhou becomes obsessed with it, leading to a digital confrontation with Leapton (Lai Gou) and a calculated attempt to befriend Lu Qian to monitor her. Lu Qian, realizing Gu Suizhou's manipulative nature, subtly undermines his confidence by recording Shen Feizhi admitting that his emoji usage is merely 'perfunctory'.
